items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Who was -- what was the teacher’s name? His name was Bud Rohs.

ctx.x: Who was -- what was the teacher’s name?

His name was Bud Rohs. He spelled his name R-o-h-s, but pronounced Ross. My father made me practice. We had a big yard, and the guys used to play baseball in the yard, my brother and his friends, some of our friends. My father would say, “No baseball until you practice that instrument.” I’d be inside practicing, watching the cats outside play baseball.
